name: @pipeworx/mcp-textcase

tools.name: convert_case
tools.description: Convert text to a target case: camel, pascal, snake, kebab, constant, title, sentence, lower, upper, dot, or slug (keyless, offline).

target.description: Target case: camel | pascal | snake | kebab | constant | title | sentence | lower | upper | dot | slug.

tools.name: all_cases
tools.description: Convert text to ALL supported cases at once and return them keyed by name.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-textcase forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the textcase pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
